node.statement: Dependency-bearing bridge for the minimizer equality: this step depends on node 1.1.3. Node 1.1.3 applies the nearest-point/minimizer fact with x = q, names the resulting minimizer r, and sets d = dist_1(q, C). Therefore that imported choice gives ||q - r||_1 = d. Multiplying this equality by the scalar 1 - s gives (1 - s)||q - r||_1 = (1 - s)d; no additional nearest-point premise is being assumed inside 1.4.3.
